motion.name: chapter
motion.purpose: Incoming chapter content and shared navigation marker.

motion.name: preview
motion.purpose: Transitions between chapter descriptions in the landing walkthrough.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Opens a review or advances the chapter.
components.css: .action { min-height: 44px; padding-inline: 17px; border: 0; border-radius: 100px; background: var(--primary, #6125eb); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 620 13px Geist, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .16s; } .action:hover { background: #4e14d0; } .action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #6125eb); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.northStar: A minimalist monthly review led by charts and diagrams
narrative.overview: Cloud Grey gives the text and charts room. Jet Black frames the illustrations. Electric Violet marks the active chapter, a measured value, or a primary action.
